blocks.text:
# contexts (shard 0..3) never report, and branch protection blocks
    # out-of-scope PRs at 27 green checks. The scope fastpass below
    # green-skips the real steps in seconds instead.
    name: Core tests (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/4)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
    # gh-1551: an empty schedule tick (no commits since the last v* tag)
    # skips this leg — the release-pending pre-check decides.
    if: needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: read
    timeout-minutes: 12
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1, 2, 3]
    steps:
      - name: Scope fastpass (out-of-scope → green in seconds)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core != 'true' && needs.changes.outputs.shared != 'true'
        run: echo "no core/shared changes — shard green-skipped (required context reported)"

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Pub cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pub-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: pub-${{ runner.os }}-

      - run: dart pub get
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      # Duration-balanced shards (issue #177 AC3): scripts/test_shards.json
      # maps test FILES to shards (file-level units — test/cli alone was
      # half the suite's runtime and undivisible as a dir-unit); rebalanced
      # weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): the fa jsr delegate suites
      # are integration-tagged (the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet measures
      # lib/src/cli hits from them), so the sharded unit run above skips
      # them. Their hits must ALSO reach the unit-side lcov consumers
      # (>= 80% ratchet, PR diff-coverage, CRAP — jsr_cli.dart at 0% reads
      # CRAP 156 > 12), so they run into shard 0's coverage dir; the gate
      # merge is a union, so one shard carrying them is enough. Keep this
      # list in sync with scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core (gh-1538
      # retired the nightly full-quality copy — the pre-merge gate is the
      # single unit-lcov producer now).
      - name: dart test --tags integration (jsr delegate trio → unit lcov)
        if: matrix.shard == 0 && (needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true')

Wait recompute: (1-cov)^3 > 12/289 = 0.04152 → 1-cov > 0.346 → cov < 65.4%. So if coalesceMessagesForCap coverage is below ~65%, CRAP > 12 → ratchet fails.

Hmm, but branch_coverage: true — branch coverage is typically lower. CRAP uses method coverage (function-level?) or line coverage? crap4dart uses the coverage % of the method — with branch_coverage true it might use branch coverage, which is usually much lower than line coverage! If coalesce's branch coverage is, say, 55%, CRAP = 289 × 0.45³ = 26.4 → FAIL. That's very plausibly the root cause.

# crap4dart configuration for flutter_agent_harness.
# https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart
#
# RATCHET: the CRAP threshold is pinned at the current worst score
# (356.34, `_handleKey` in bin/../tui_repl.dart) — pushes may only make
# the codebase BETTER, never worse. Lower the threshold whenever the top
# offenders are fixed (run: dart pub global run crap4dart analyze).

sources: [lib, bin]

exclude:
  - '**.g.dart'
  - '**.freezed.dart'
  - '**.mocks.dart'
  - 'build/**'
  - 'vendor/**'

crap:
  enabled: true
  # Current max CRAP score in the repo: 12.0 (re-measured whole-tree on
  # the merged-suite lcov, #1234 rework). The card's named offenders DID
  # move — readPasteboardImage 16.32 (split into fake-seam /
  # platform-dispatch helpers), the CC-12 trio (_handleTreeKey,
  # discoverTaskAgents, _rebuild) split into cohesive sub-dispatchers,
  # the four 0%-cov CC-3 methods covered by tests (frontmatter, video
  # endpoint, below-window ingest, provider picker), the named CC-9 tier
  # split, and _listModels (20 @ 0%) covered by the line-mode /models
  # test. But the FIRST real whole-tree measurement (the authoring box
  # had no dart toolchain) shows the 12.0 → 8.0 repin is not earned yet:
  # 137 methods measure above 8.0 — 54 at exactly 12.00 (the CC-3 @ 0%
  # tier + fully-covered CC-12 dispatchers) and 83 at 9.00 (CC-9 @ 100%).
  # Threshold stays at the measured max; the 12.00/9.00 tier is the next
  # ladder card (cover the CC-3@0% half, split the CC-12 dispatchers,
  # then the threshold follows down to 8.0). Only down from here.
  threshold: 12.0
  # _listModels used to hit 20 with 0% coverage (line-mode-only output);
  # covered by test/cli/provider_models_line_mode_test.dart in #1234.

# ─── loc gate (issue #1234, gh-1232 migration) ─────────────────────────────
# The ≤2800-line file guard MOVED from scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_size +
# the ci.yml shell find-exec guards onto crap4dart's `loc` gate (0.11.0,
# maintainer-confirmed wc -l semantics). Enforced whole-tree on every merge
# validation via `crap4dart check --baseline` (CI quality-gates step) and
# staged files in the pre-commit hook — no staged-scoping escape, no
# hook-dependence, merge-bot merges included. max_lines only DOWN;
# app_localizations.dart is gen-l10n OUTPUT (no .g.dart suffix) — excluded,
# not baselined.

coverage:
  # scripts/pre-commit regenerates this (dart test --coverage) right
  # before the CRAP step runs.
  lcov_path: coverage/lcov.info
  required: true
  branch_coverage: true
  # crap4dart 0.9.5 flipped the run_tests default to true — a bare
  # `analyze`/`check` would silently re-run the whole core suite first.
  # Coverage is regenerated explicitly (pre-commit hook, CI shard merge);
  # do not pay for it twice.
  run_tests: false

# ─── Gates (issue #447) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 0.9.5 default-enables ALL built-in gates; only broken_goldens is
# enforced here, everything else is disabled explicitly so a bare
# `check --staged` (pre-commit, core-only #433 split) means exactly the
# pixel gate. The flutter_app goldens live in flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml.
gates:
  # Issue #1234: the whole-tree ≤2800-line guard (was stage_size +
  # ci.yml shell find-exec, gh-1232). wc -l semantics, generated output
  # excluded — nothing exceeds 2800 today, so the shrink-only baseline
  # starts EMPTY of loc entries. Scope = the package sources [lib, bin]:
  # 0.11.0 has NO per-gate sources override (gates.loc.sources is a
  # ConfigException — caught by CI on 019ede65), and the top-level
  # sources drive the CRAP census too, so they stay untouched. test/ and
  # example/ are enforced by the companion config
  # crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml (same loc gate, sources [test, example]);
  # the app package's own config covers flutter_app/lib.
  loc:
    enabled: true
    max_lines: 2800
    exclude:
      - '**.g.dart'
      - '**.freezed.dart'
      - '**.mocks.dart'
      - 'vendor/**'
  test_coverage: {enabled: false} # own ≥80% coverage-gate job
  complexity: {enabled: false} # CRAP ratchet above already covers it
  method_size: {enabled: false}
  nesting: {enabled: false}
  class_size: {enabled: false}
  weight_of_class: {enabled: false}
  unused_code: {enabled: false}
  unused_files: {enabled: false} # follow-up card (issue #1234 §5). Known
    # FPs to exclude when enabling: the conditional-export IO entry points
    # (lib/io.dart, lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart — public barrels whose
    # importers live outside this repo's import graph) and shared pinned
    # data modules imported only from test/ (lib/src/cli/omp_reg_scenarios.dart,
    # issue #810). lib/fanet.dart was the one confirmed-dead hit — deleted
    # in #1234.
  banned_imports: {enabled: false}
  # Type-2 duplication gate (issue #1106, crap4dart 0.11.0). Renamed-clone
  # detection on top of the Type-1 default; the union with the raw pass can
  # only ADD findings, never lose exact copies. severity: warning starts
  # soft — escalate to error once the 13-file triage debt is paid
  # (follow-up, owner-side). The global jscpd <1% guards stay as-is.
  #
  # Two suppression channels with different contracts:
  # - `// crap:ignore` (needs ignorable: true) = a JUSTIFIED structural
  #   twin, suppressed forever, with a one-line reason in the comment.
  # - `.crap-baseline.json` (via `check --baseline`) = LEGACY debt; the
  #   committed snapshot must only SHRINK: after each triage batch re-run
  #   `dart pub global run crap4dart check --save-baseline` and commit the
  #   only-down diff, or the snapshot rots and starts masking shifts.
  #
  # WINDOW (until severity flips to error): the gate never fails a build —
  # new (not-baselined) duplication only surfaces as a `[WARN]` line in
  # `check` output. Enforcement becomes hard exactly when the owner-side
  # escalation lands; from then on any finding outside the two channels
  # fails CI/pre-commit.
  duplication:
    enabled: true
    severity: warning
    ignorable: true # enables `// crap:ignore` for justified structural twins
    ignore_locals: true # Type-2: rename locals before hashing (API names stay)
    ignore_literals: false # keeps l10n/theme/symbol tables out
    sources: # cross-module scope from #487
      - flutter_app/lib
      - packages/fa_ui/lib
      - packages/fa_llm/lib
  file_naming: {enabled: false}
  magic_constants: {enabled: false}
  test_assertions: {enabled: false}
  folder_structure: {enabled: false}
  external: {enabled: false}
  public_docs: {enabled: false}
  golden: {enabled: false} # flutter-only gate (core is not a Flutter project)
  accessibility: {enabled: false}
  hardcoded_strings: {enabled: false}

  # Pixel gate over core test/ goldens — none exist today, so this is a
  # no-op that guards the future (issue #447 AC: "and core test/ goldens
  # if any appear"). WARNING, same rationale as flutter_app: the 0.9.5
  # detector misses the Ahem-solid-rect and hollow-square classes and
  # false-positives on V-converging shapes; flip to error when the
  # upstream detector fixes land.
  broken_goldens:
    enabled: true
    severity: warning
    dirs: [test]
    exclude:
      # TUI screenshots, not goldens: amber/yellow text on the dark theme
      # trips the stripe heuristic (measured 14/14 "overflow stripes" —
      # the same yellow-on-dark detector bug the issue documents for
      # apps_panel/panel_dark). Revisit when upstream fixes land.
      - 'test/integration/**'

The guards job runs:

But CRAP score with no coverage would treat everything as 0% covered → scores skyrocket → ratchet would fail... but coverage required:true would error if missing.

But baseline check: `.crap-baseline.json` must only shrink? "the committed snapshot must only SHRINK" — maybe check --baseline fails if baseline entries no longer match or if new findings exist.

# contexts (shard 0..3) never report, and branch protection blocks
    # out-of-scope PRs at 27 green checks. The scope fastpass below
    # green-skips the real steps in seconds instead.
    name: Core tests (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/4)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
    # gh-1551: an empty schedule tick (no commits since the last v* tag)
    # skips this leg — the release-pending pre-check decides.
    if: needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: read
    timeout-minutes: 12
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1, 2, 3]
    steps:
      - name: Scope fastpass (out-of-scope → green in seconds)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core != 'true' && needs.changes.outputs.shared != 'true'
        run: echo "no core/shared changes — shard green-skipped (required context reported)"

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Pub cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pub-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: pub-${{ runner.os }}-

      - run: dart pub get
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      # Duration-balanced shards (issue #177 AC3): scripts/test_shards.json
      # maps test FILES to shards (file-level units — test/cli alone was
      # half the suite's runtime and undivisible as a dir-unit); rebalanced
      # weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): the fa jsr delegate suites
      # are integration-tagged (the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet measures
      # lib/src/cli hits from them), so the sharded unit run above skips
      # them. Their hits must ALSO reach the unit-side lcov consumers
      # (>= 80% ratchet, PR diff-coverage, CRAP — jsr_cli.dart at 0% reads
      # CRAP 156 > 12), so they run into shard 0's coverage dir; the gate
      # merge is a union, so one shard carrying them is enough. Keep this
      # list in sync with scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core (gh-1538
      # retired the nightly full-quality copy — the pre-merge gate is the
      # single unit-lcov producer now).
      - name: dart test --tags integration (jsr delegate trio → unit lcov)
        if: matrix.shard == 0 && (needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true')

blocks.text:
# contexts (shard 0..3) never report, and branch protection blocks
    # out-of-scope PRs at 27 green checks. The scope fastpass below
    # green-skips the real steps in seconds instead.
    name: Core tests (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/4)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
    # gh-1551: an empty schedule tick (no commits since the last v* tag)
    # skips this leg — the release-pending pre-check decides.
    if: needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: read
    timeout-minutes: 12
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1, 2, 3]
    steps:
      - name: Scope fastpass (out-of-scope → green in seconds)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core != 'true' && needs.changes.outputs.shared != 'true'
        run: echo "no core/shared changes — shard green-skipped (required context reported)"

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Pub cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pub-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: pub-${{ runner.os }}-

      - run: dart pub get
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      # Duration-balanced shards (issue #177 AC3): scripts/test_shards.json
      # maps test FILES to shards (file-level units — test/cli alone was
      # half the suite's runtime and undivisible as a dir-unit); rebalanced
      # weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): the fa jsr delegate suites
      # are integration-tagged (the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet measures
      # lib/src/cli hits from them), so the sharded unit run above skips
      # them. Their hits must ALSO reach the unit-side lcov consumers
      # (>= 80% ratchet, PR diff-coverage, CRAP — jsr_cli.dart at 0% reads
      # CRAP 156 > 12), so they run into shard 0's coverage dir; the gate
      # merge is a union, so one shard carrying them is enough. Keep this
      # list in sync with scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core (gh-1538
      # retired the nightly full-quality copy — the pre-merge gate is the
      # single unit-lcov producer now).
      - name: dart test --tags integration (jsr delegate trio → unit lcov)
        if: matrix.shard == 0 && (needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true')

The CI runs `dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration` across 4 shards, then merges lcov. Locally I'll run the same in background: `dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration`. Note known pre-existing failures mentioned in the PR description (headless_log_file_test 4, yolo 2, job_board 1, tui snapshot malloc abort). dart test would exit nonzero on failures but still produce coverage. I need coverage/lcov.info: `dart test --coverage=coverage` produces JSON coverage in coverage/; then format: `dart pub global run coverage:format_coverage --lcov --in=coverage --out=coverage/lcov.info --report-on=lib --packages=.dart_tool/package_config.json`. Check scripts/merge_lcov.py or pre-commit hook for the exact format command.

`coalesceMessagesForCap` has CC 17. CRAP = CC² × (1 − cov)³ = 289 × (1−cov)³. Threshold 12. So even at 90% coverage: 289×0.001=0.29 — fine. At 80% coverage: 289×0.008=2.3. The danger zone is coverage < ~40%: at cov 0% → 289 FAIL. The coalesce test file has 258 lines of tests covering several scenarios; but CC 17 means many branches — partial coverage could leave CRAP > 12 if coverage < ~42% (289×(1-cov)³ > 12 → (1-cov)³ > 0.0415 → 1-cov > 0.346 → cov < 65.4%). Wait recompute: (1-cov)^3 > 12/289 = 0.04152 → 1-cov > 0.346 → cov < 65.4%. So if coalesceMessagesForCap coverage is below ~65%, CRAP > 12 → ratchet fails.

Hmm, but branch_coverage: true — branch coverage is typically lower. CRAP uses method coverage (function-level?) or line coverage? crap4dart uses the coverage % of the method — with branch_coverage true it might use branch coverage, which is usually much lower than line coverage! If coalesce's branch coverage is, say, 55%, CRAP = 289 × 0.45³ = 26.4 → FAIL. That's very plausibly the root cause.

So the fix: reduce complexity of coalesceMessagesForCap (split into helpers) and/or add tests to cover branches. TDD: write tests to raise coverage; and refactor to lower CC.

# contexts (shard 0..3) never report, and branch protection blocks
    # out-of-scope PRs at 27 green checks. The scope fastpass below
    # green-skips the real steps in seconds instead.
    name: Core tests (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/4)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
    # gh-1551: an empty schedule tick (no commits since the last v* tag)
    # skips this leg — the release-pending pre-check decides.
    if: needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: read
    timeout-minutes: 12
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1, 2, 3]
    steps:
      - name: Scope fastpass (out-of-scope → green in seconds)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core != 'true' && needs.changes.outputs.shared != 'true'
        run: echo "no core/shared changes — shard green-skipped (required context reported)"

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Pub cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pub-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: pub-${{ runner.os }}-

      - run: dart pub get
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      # Duration-balanced shards (issue #177 AC3): scripts/test_shards.json
      # maps test FILES to shards (file-level units — test/cli alone was
      # half the suite's runtime and undivisible as a dir-unit); rebalanced
      # weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): the fa jsr delegate suites
      # are integration-tagged (the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet measures
      # lib/src/cli hits from them), so the sharded unit run above skips
      # them. Their hits must ALSO reach the unit-side lcov consumers
      # (>= 80% ratchet, PR diff-coverage, CRAP — jsr_cli.dart at 0% reads
      # CRAP 156 > 12), so they run into shard 0's coverage dir; the gate
      # merge is a union, so one shard carrying them is enough. Keep this
      # list in sync with scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core (gh-1538
      # retired the nightly full-quality copy — the pre-merge gate is the
      # single unit-lcov producer now).
      - name: dart test --tags integration (jsr delegate trio → unit lcov)
        if: matrix.shard == 0 && (needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true')

blocks.text:
# contexts (shard 0..3) never report, and branch protection blocks
    # out-of-scope PRs at 27 green checks. The scope fastpass below
    # green-skips the real steps in seconds instead.
    name: Core tests (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/4)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
    # gh-1551: an empty schedule tick (no commits since the last v* tag)
    # skips this leg — the release-pending pre-check decides.
    if: needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: read
    timeout-minutes: 12
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1, 2, 3]
    steps:
      - name: Scope fastpass (out-of-scope → green in seconds)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core != 'true' && needs.changes.outputs.shared != 'true'
        run: echo "no core/shared changes — shard green-skipped (required context reported)"

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Pub cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pub-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: pub-${{ runner.os }}-

      - run: dart pub get
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      # Duration-balanced shards (issue #177 AC3): scripts/test_shards.json
      # maps test FILES to shards (file-level units — test/cli alone was
      # half the suite's runtime and undivisible as a dir-unit); rebalanced
      # weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): the fa jsr delegate suites
      # are integration-tagged (the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet measures
      # lib/src/cli hits from them), so the sharded unit run above skips
      # them. Their hits must ALSO reach the unit-side lcov consumers
      # (>= 80% ratchet, PR diff-coverage, CRAP — jsr_cli.dart at 0% reads
      # CRAP 156 > 12), so they run into shard 0's coverage dir; the gate
      # merge is a union, so one shard carrying them is enough. Keep this
      # list in sync with scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core (gh-1538
      # retired the nightly full-quality copy — the pre-merge gate is the
      # single unit-lcov producer now).
      - name: dart test --tags integration (jsr delegate trio → unit lcov)
        if: matrix.shard == 0 && (needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true')

# contexts (shard 0..3) never report, and branch protection blocks
    # out-of-scope PRs at 27 green checks. The scope fastpass below
    # green-skips the real steps in seconds instead.
    name: Core tests (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/4)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
    # gh-1551: an empty schedule tick (no commits since the last v* tag)
    # skips this leg — the release-pending pre-check decides.
    if: needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: read
    timeout-minutes: 12
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1, 2, 3]
    steps:
      - name: Scope fastpass (out-of-scope → green in seconds)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core != 'true' && needs.changes.outputs.shared != 'true'
        run: echo "no core/shared changes — shard green-skipped (required context reported)"

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Pub cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pub-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: pub-${{ runner.os }}-

      - run: dart pub get
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      # Duration-balanced shards (issue #177 AC3): scripts/test_shards.json
      # maps test FILES to shards (file-level units — test/cli alone was
      # half the suite's runtime and undivisible as a dir-unit); rebalanced
      # weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): the fa jsr delegate suites
      # are integration-tagged (the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet measures
      # lib/src/cli hits from them), so the sharded unit run above skips
      # them. Their hits must ALSO reach the unit-side lcov consumers
      # (>= 80% ratchet, PR diff-coverage, CRAP — jsr_cli.dart at 0% reads
      # CRAP 156 > 12), so they run into shard 0's coverage dir; the gate
      # merge is a union, so one shard carrying them is enough. Keep this
      # list in sync with scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core (gh-1538
      # retired the nightly full-quality copy — the pre-merge gate is the
      # single unit-lcov producer now).
      - name: dart test --tags integration (jsr delegate trio → unit lcov)
        if: matrix.shard == 0 && (needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true')

`coalesceMessagesForCap` has CC 17. CRAP = CC² × (1 − cov)³ = 289 × (1−cov)³. Threshold 12. So even at 90% coverage: 289×0.001=0.29 — fine. At 80% coverage: 289×0.008=2.3. The danger zone is coverage < ~40%: at cov 0% → 289 FAIL. The coalesce test file has 258 lines of tests covering several scenarios; but CC 17 means many branches — partial coverage could leave CRAP > 12 if coverage < ~42% (289×(1-cov)³ > 12 → (1-cov)³ > 0.0415 → 1-cov > 0.346 → cov < 65.4%). Wait recompute: (1-cov)^3 > 12/289 = 0.04152 → 1-cov > 0.346 → cov < 65.4%. So if coalesceMessagesForCap coverage is below ~65%, CRAP > 12 → ratchet fails.

Hmm, but branch_coverage: true — branch coverage is typically lower. CRAP uses method coverage (function-level?) or line coverage? crap4dart uses the coverage % of the method — with branch_coverage true it might use branch coverage, which is usually much lower than line coverage! If coalesce's branch coverage is, say, 55%, CRAP = 289 × 0.45³ = 26.4 → FAIL. That's very plausibly the root cause.

So the fix: reduce complexity of coalesceMessagesForCap (split into helpers) and/or add tests to cover branches. TDD: write tests to raise coverage; and refactor to lower CC.

blocks.text:
# contexts (shard 0..3) never report, and branch protection blocks
    # out-of-scope PRs at 27 green checks. The scope fastpass below
    # green-skips the real steps in seconds instead.
    name: Core tests (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/4)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
    # gh-1551: an empty schedule tick (no commits since the last v* tag)
    # skips this leg — the release-pending pre-check decides.
    if: needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: read
    timeout-minutes: 12
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1, 2, 3]
    steps:
      - name: Scope fastpass (out-of-scope → green in seconds)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core != 'true' && needs.changes.outputs.shared != 'true'
        run: echo "no core/shared changes — shard green-skipped (required context reported)"

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Pub cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pub-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: pub-${{ runner.os }}-

      - run: dart pub get
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      # Duration-balanced shards (issue #177 AC3): scripts/test_shards.json
      # maps test FILES to shards (file-level units — test/cli alone was
      # half the suite's runtime and undivisible as a dir-unit); rebalanced
      # weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): the fa jsr delegate suites
      # are integration-tagged (the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet measures
      # lib/src/cli hits from them), so the sharded unit run above skips
      # them. Their hits must ALSO reach the unit-side lcov consumers
      # (>= 80% ratchet, PR diff-coverage, CRAP — jsr_cli.dart at 0% reads
      # CRAP 156 > 12), so they run into shard 0's coverage dir; the gate
      # merge is a union, so one shard carrying them is enough. Keep this
      # list in sync with scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core (gh-1538
      # retired the nightly full-quality copy — the pre-merge gate is the
      # single unit-lcov producer now).
      - name: dart test --tags integration (jsr delegate trio → unit lcov)
        if: matrix.shard == 0 && (needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true')

The CI runs `dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration` across 4 shards, then merges lcov. `coalesceMessagesForCap` has CC 17. CRAP = CC² × (1 − cov)³ = 289 × (1−cov)³. Threshold 12. So even at 90% coverage: 289×0.001=0.29 — fine. At 80% coverage: 289×0.008=2.3. The danger zone is coverage < ~40%: at cov 0% → 289 FAIL. The coalesce test file has 258 lines of tests covering several scenarios; but CC 17 means many branches — partial coverage could leave CRAP > 12 if coverage < ~42% (289×(1-cov)³ > 12 → (1-cov)³ > 0.0415 → 1-cov > 0.346 → cov < 65.4%). Wait recompute: (1-cov)^3 > 12/289 = 0.04152 → 1-cov > 0.346 → cov < 65.4%. So if coalesceMessagesForCap coverage is below ~65%, CRAP > 12 → ratchet fails.

Hmm, but branch_coverage: true — branch coverage is typically lower. CRAP uses method coverage (function-level?) or line coverage? crap4dart uses the coverage % of the method — with branch_coverage true it might use branch coverage, which is usually much lower than line coverage! If coalesce's branch coverage is, say, 55%, CRAP = 289 × 0.45³ = 26.4 → FAIL. That's very plausibly the root cause.

So the fix: reduce complexity of coalesceMessagesForCap (split into helpers) and/or add tests to cover branches. TDD: write tests to raise coverage; and refactor to lower CC.

blocks.text:
# contexts (shard 0..3) never report, and branch protection blocks
    # out-of-scope PRs at 27 green checks. The scope fastpass below
    # green-skips the real steps in seconds instead.
    name: Core tests (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/4)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
    # gh-1551: an empty schedule tick (no commits since the last v* tag)
    # skips this leg — the release-pending pre-check decides.
    if: needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: read
    timeout-minutes: 12
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1, 2, 3]
    steps:
      - name: Scope fastpass (out-of-scope → green in seconds)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core != 'true' && needs.changes.outputs.shared != 'true'
        run: echo "no core/shared changes — shard green-skipped (required context reported)"

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Pub cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pub-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: pub-${{ runner.os }}-

      - run: dart pub get
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      # Duration-balanced shards (issue #177 AC3): scripts/test_shards.json
      # maps test FILES to shards (file-level units — test/cli alone was
      # half the suite's runtime and undivisible as a dir-unit); rebalanced
      # weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): the fa jsr delegate suites

# Rework — gh-1680 / PR #1695: fix CRAP ratchet failure (Quality gate + CRAP + duplication)

## Issues/Notes

- **CI failure root cause** (both red checks trace to one leg): the `Quality gate`
  aggregate reddens because the `CRAP + duplication` (guards) job failed, and its
  `CRAP ratchet` step (`dart pub global run crap4dart analyze` over the merged
  shard lcov) was the failing step. The job logs were not fetchable
  (`ci_failures_full.log` — both job logs came back empty), so the failure was
  reproduced locally step-by-step:
  - `crap4dart check --baseline` — PASS locally (broken goldens clean, loc gate
    within limits, Type-2 duplication is warning-severity).
  - `jscpd` duplication guard (`lib/` < 1%) — 0.77%, PASS.
  - Cross-module duplication ratchet (`ci_fast_gate.sh --stages dupx`) — 0.23% <
    0.31%, PASS.
  - Loc-scope gate (`test/` + `example/` ≤ 280 lines) — PASS.
  - **CRAP ratchet — RED reproduced**: `coalesceMessagesForCap`

    name: Core tests (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/4)

    # skips this leg — the release-pending pre-check decides.
    if: needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: read
    timeout-minutes: 12
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1, 2, 3]
    steps:
      - name: Scope fastpass (out-of-scope → green in seconds)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core != 'true' && needs.changes.outputs.shared != 'true'
        run: echo "no core/shared changes — shard green-skipped (required context reported)"

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Pub cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache

          restore-keys: pub-${{ runner.os }}-

      - run: dart pub get
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0

`coalesceMessagesForCap` has CC 17. CRAP = CC² × (1 − cov)³ = 289 × (1−cov)³. Threshold 12. So even at 90% coverage: 289×0.001=0.29 — fine. At 80% coverage: 289×0.008=2.3. The danger zone is coverage < ~40%: at cov 0% → 289 FAIL. The coalesce test file has 258 lines of tests covering several scenarios; but CC 17 means many branches — partial coverage could leave CRAP > 12 if coverage < ~42% (289×(1-cov)³ > 12 → (1-cov)³ > 0.0415 → 1-cov > 0.346 → cov < 65.4%). Wait recompute: (1-cov)^3 > 12/289 = 0.04152 → 1-cov > 0.346 → cov < 65.4%. So if coalesceMessagesForCap coverage is below ~65%, CRAP > 12 → ratchet fails.

Hmm, but branch_coverage: true — branch coverage is typically lower. CRAP uses method coverage (function-level?) or line coverage? crap4dart uses the coverage % of the method — with branch_coverage true it might use branch coverage, which is usually much lower than line coverage! If coalesce's branch coverage is, say, 55%, CRAP = 289 × 0.45³ = 26.4 → FAIL. That's very plausibly the root cause.

So the fix: reduce complexity of coalesceMessagesForCap (split into helpers) and/or add tests to cover branches. TDD: write tests to raise coverage; and refactor to lower CC.

    line coverage** against the pinned threshold of 12.0. The CRAP formula is
    `CC² × (1−cov)³ + CC`, so a CC-17 method reads ≥ 17 *even fully covered* —
    no test coverage could ever make it pass. It is the only diff-added method

suite as the behavior pin:

`coalesceMessagesForCap` has CC 17. CRAP = CC² × (1 − cov)³ = 289 × (1−cov)³. Threshold 12. So even at 90% coverage: 289×0.001=0.29 — fine. At 80% coverage: 289×0.008=2.3. The danger zone is coverage < ~40%: at cov 0% → 289 FAIL. The coalesce test file has 258 lines of tests covering several scenarios; but CC 17 means many branches — partial coverage could leave CRAP > 12 if coverage < ~42% (289×(1-cov)³ > 12 → (1-cov)³ > 0.0415 → 1-cov > 0.346 → cov < 65.4%). Wait recompute: (1-cov)^3 > 12/289 = 0.04152 → 1-cov > 0.346 → cov < 65.4%. So if coalesceMessagesForCap coverage is below ~65%, CRAP > 12 → ratchet fails.

Hmm, but branch_coverage: true — branch coverage is typically lower. CRAP uses method coverage (function-level?) or line coverage? crap4dart uses the coverage % of the method — with branch_coverage true it might use branch coverage, which is usually much lower than line coverage! If coalesce's branch coverage is, say, 55%, CRAP = 289 × 0.45³ = 26.4 → FAIL. That's very plausibly the root cause.

So the fix: reduce complexity of coalesceMessagesForCap (split into helpers) and/or add tests to cover branches. TDD: write tests to raise coverage; and refactor to lower CC.

`coalesceMessagesForCap` has CC 17. CRAP = CC² × (1 − cov)³ = 289 × (1−cov)³. Threshold 12. So even at 90% coverage: 289×0.001=0.29 — fine. At 80% coverage: 289×0.008=2.3. The danger zone is coverage < ~40%: at cov 0% → 289 FAIL. The coalesce test file has 258 lines of tests covering several scenarios; but CC 17 means many branches — partial coverage could leave CRAP > 12 if coverage < ~42% (289×(1-cov)³ > 12 → (1-cov)³ > 0.0415 → 1-cov > 0.346 → cov < 65.4%). Wait recompute: (1-cov)^3 > 12/289 = 0.04152 → 1-cov > 0.346 → cov < 65.4%. So if coalesceMessagesForCap coverage is below ~65%, CRAP > 12 → ratchet fails.

Hmm, but branch_coverage: true — branch coverage is typically lower. CRAP uses method coverage (function-level?) or line coverage? crap4dart uses the coverage % of the method — with branch_coverage true it might use branch coverage, which is usually much lower than line coverage! If coalesce's branch coverage is, say, 55%, CRAP = 289 × 0.45³ = 26.4 → FAIL. That's very plausibly the root cause.

So the fix: reduce complexity of coalesceMessagesForCap (split into helpers) and/or add tests to cover branches. TDD: write tests to raise coverage; and refactor to lower CC.

    `CC² × (1−cov)³ + CC`, so a CC-17 method reads ≥ 17 *even fully covered* —

`coalesceMessagesForCap` has CC 17. CRAP = CC² × (1 − cov)³ = 289 × (1−cov)³. Threshold 12. So even at 90% coverage: 289×0.001=0.29 — fine. At 80% coverage: 289×0.008=2.3. The danger zone is coverage < ~40%: at cov 0% → 289 FAIL. The coalesce test file has 258 lines of tests covering several scenarios; but CC 17 means many branches — partial coverage could leave CRAP > 12 if coverage < ~42% (289×(1-cov)³ > 12 → (1-cov)³ > 0.0415 → 1-cov > 0.346 → cov < 65.4%). Wait recompute: (1-cov)^3 > 12/289 = 0.04152 → 1-cov > 0.346 → cov < 65.4%. So if coalesceMessagesForCap coverage is below ~65%, CRAP > 12 → ratchet fails.

Hmm, but branch_coverage: true — branch coverage is typically lower. `coalesceMessagesForCap` has CC 17. CRAP = CC² × (1 − cov)³ = 289 × (1−cov)³. Threshold 12. So even at 90% coverage: 289×0.001=0.29 — fine. At 80% coverage: 289×0.008=2.3. The danger zone is coverage < ~40%: at cov 0% → 289 FAIL. The coalesce test file has 258 lines of tests covering several scenarios; but CC 17 means many branches — partial coverage could leave CRAP > 12 if coverage < ~42% (289×(1-cov)³ > 12 → (1-cov)³ > 0.0415 → 1-cov > 0.346 → cov < 65.4%). Wait recompute: (1-cov)^3 > 12/289 = 0.04152 → 1-cov > 0.346 → cov < 65.4%. So if coalesceMessagesForCap coverage is below ~65%, CRAP > 12 → ratchet fails.

Hmm, but branch_coverage: true — branch coverage is typically lower. CRAP uses method coverage (function-level?) or line coverage? crap4dart uses the coverage % of the method — with branch_coverage true it might use branch coverage, which is usually much lower than line coverage! If coalesce's branch coverage is, say, 55%, CRAP = 289 × 0.45³ = 26.4 → FAIL. That's very plausibly the root cause.

So the fix: reduce complexity of coalesceMessagesForCap (split into helpers) and/or add tests to cover branches. TDD: write tests to raise coverage; and refactor to lower CC.

# Rework — gh-1680 / PR #1695: fix CRAP ratchet + loc gate failures (Quality gate + CRAP + duplication)

## Issues/Notes

- **CI failure root cause** (both red checks trace to one leg): the `Quality gate`
  aggregate reddens because the `CRAP + duplication` (guards) job failed. The
  job logs were not fetchable (`ci_failures_full.log` — both job logs came back
  empty), so the failure was reproduced locally step-by-step against the pinned
  `crap4dart 0.11.0`:
  - `crap4dart check --baseline` — the failing step family, see below.
  - `jscpd` duplication guard (`lib/` < 1%) — 0.77%, PASS.
  - Cross-module duplication ratchet (`ci_fast_gate.sh --stages dupx`) — 0.23% <
    0.31%, PASS.
  - Loc-scope gate (`test/` + `example/` ≤ 280 lines) — PASS.
  - **CRAP ratchet (`crap4dart analyze` over the merged shard lcov) — RED
    reproduced.** CRAP = `CC² × (1−cov)³ + CC`, so any method with cyclomatic
    complexity > 12 fails *even at 100% coverage*. The PR pushed three methods
    onto/over the pinned 12.0 ceiling:
    1. `coalesceMessagesForCap` (`lib/src/agent/message_cap.dart`) — **CC 17 →
       CRAP 17.00** at 97.6% coverage. Only offender visible without full
       coverage (all other new/touched units measured CC ≤ 11).
    2. `_streamAssistantResponse` (`lib/src/agent/agent_loop.dart`) — the
       gh-1680 cap-heal block added 3 branches → **CC 14 → CRAP 14.00** (visible
       only on the full-suite lcov — with partial lcov it reads N/A).
    3. `_buildRequestContext` (same file) — the cap-coalesce `if` added 1
       branch → CC 12, i.e. CRAP 12.0000x at anything short of exactly 100%
       coverage (razor-edge; observed 12.0003 at 98.7%).
  - **Loc gate — RED reproduced after the first fix**: extracting the attempt
    body inline grew `agent_loop.dart` to 2816 lines > 2800. Resolved by moving
    the attempt body into the existing `agent_loop_message_cap.dart` part file
    (the seat created exactly for this gate; file now 2708 lines).
- Open review threads: **0** (all 6 resolved in earlier laps; the PR carries an
  APPROVE verdict). No `review_replies.json` entries required — written as
  `{ "replies": [] }`.

## Approach

TDD against the ratchet itself (the CI-visible failure), with the existing
suite as the behavior pin (pure control-flow/function-boundary refactor — no
wire semantics, event order, or repair logic changed):

1. **RED** — targeted + full-suite lcov merges reproduced all three CRAP
   breaches and the loc breach (17.00, 14.00, 12.0003, 2816 > 2800).
2. **GREEN** — complexity split, semantics preserved:
   - `message_cap.dart`: `coalesceMessagesForCap` (CC 17) →
     `_coalesceRegionEnd` (3), `_groupCoalesceUnits` (6), `_collectToolGroup`
     (6), `_mergeCarriersToTarget` (3), parent (3). The PR #1695 verbatim
     split-group handling, displaced-result hoisting, carrier merge order, and
     `repairToolPairing` belt-and-suspenders are untouched.
   - `agent_loop.dart` / `agent_loop_message_cap.dart`: the retry-loop body
     moved to `_streamAttempt` (CC 9); the finished-turn branch handling
     (cap heal → pairing heal) moved to `_finishedTurnResult` (CC 4); both
     resolve to a sealed `_AttemptResult` (`_AttemptReturn`/`_AttemptRetry`)
     consumed by an exhaustive switch in `_streamAssistantResponse` (CC 7).
     Cross-attempt one-shot flags (`reliefUsed`, `pairingHealed`) propagate
     through the retry value; `context` adoption is identical.
   - `_buildRequestContext` (CC 12 → 11): the nullable coalesce branch folded
     into `_applyMessageCapCoalesce` (CC 2) in the part file.
   - `_streamAttempt` + verdict types + `_finishedTurnResult` live in the part
     file — keeps `agent_loop.dart` at 2708 lines (gate ≤ 2800).
3. **REFACTOR/verify** — `dart format` + `dart analyze` clean; whole-tree
   `crap4dart analyze` on the merged lcov: **Max CRAP 12.00 — OK** (remaining
   12.00 entries are pre-existing files untouched by this diff); `check
   --baseline` 3 passed / 1 warned (duplication is warning-severity by
   config) / 0 failed.

## Files Modified

- `lib/src/agent/message_cap.dart` — `coalesceMessagesForCap` split into four
  cohesive helpers (all ≤ CC 6).
- `lib/src/agent/agent_loop.dart` — `_streamAssistantResponse` now only owns
  the retry loop + cross-attempt state; `_streamAttempt` and the coalesce
  call-site branch moved out.
- `lib/src/agent/agent_loop_message_cap.dart` — hosts `_streamAttempt`, the
  `_AttemptResult` verdict types, `_finishedTurnResult`, and
  `_applyMessageCapCoalesce`.

## Test Coverage

- RED: `crap4dart analyze` — CRAP 17.00 / 14.00 / 12.0003 > 12.0 on the
  merged lcov; loc gate 2816 > 2800 — the CI failures reproduced locally.
- GREEN: 507/507 `test/agent/` + `overflow_test` pass on the final tree;
  545/545 broader agent+wire+cli-cap set passed on the intermediate tree;
  all behavior pins (PR #1695 steering-interleave probes, E1 one-shot group,
  pairing invariants AC6, JSONL byte-identity AC7) intact.
- Post-fix whole-tree CRAP on merged lcov (full suite + fresh records for the
  three edited files + the integration-tagged jsr trio): **Max CRAP 12.00 —
  OK, exit 0**; `check --baseline` PASS; jscpd 0.77% < 1%; dupx 0.23% < 0.31%;
  loc-scope PASS.
- Full core suite (`dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags
  integration`, 11,381 tests) run twice over the rework: first lap all green
  (11381 passed / 11 skipped / 0 failed); final lap re-run after the
  part-file move to keep the verification on a frozen tree.

       branch → CC 12, i.e. CRAP 12.0000x at anything short of exactly 100%

TDD against the ratchet itself (the CI-visible failure), with the existing

    reproduced.** CRAP = `CC² × (1−cov)³ + CC`, so any method with cyclomatic
    complexity > 12 fails *even at 100% coverage*. The PR pushed three methods

       branch → CC 12, i.e. CRAP 12.0000x at anything short of exactly 100%
       coverage (razor-edge; observed 12.0003 at 98.7%).

    body inline grew `agent_loop.dart` to 2816 lines > 2800. Resolved by moving

  APPROVE verdict). No `review_replies.json` entries required — written as

TDD against the ratchet itself (the CI-visible failure), with the existing
suite as the behavior pin (pure control-flow/function-boundary refactor — no
wire semantics, event order, or repair logic changed):

     Cross-attempt one-shot flags (`reliefUsed`, `pairingHealed`) propagate

   - `_buildRequestContext` (CC 12 → 11): the nullable coalesce branch folded

{"content":"# Rework — gh-1680 / PR #1695: fix CRAP ratchet + loc gate failures (Quality gate + CRAP + duplication)

## Issues/Notes

- **CI failure root cause** (both red checks trace to one leg): the `Quality gate`
  aggregate reddens because the `CRAP + duplication` (guards) job failed. The
  job logs were not fetchable (`ci_failures_full.log` — both job logs came back
  empty), so the failure was reproduced locally step-by-step against the pinned
  `crap4dart 0.11.0`:
  - `crap4dart check --baseline` — the failing step family, see below.
  - `jscpd` duplication guard (`lib/` < 1%) — 0.77%, PASS.
  - Cross-module duplication ratchet (`ci_fast_gate.sh --stages dupx`) — 0.23% <
    0.31%, PASS.
  - Loc-scope gate (`test/` + `example/` ≤ 280 lines) — PASS.
  - **CRAP ratchet (`crap4dart analyze` over the merged shard lcov) — RED
    reproduced.** CRAP = `CC² × (1−cov)³ + CC`, so any method with cyclomatic
    complexity > 12 fails *even at 100% coverage*. The PR pushed three methods
    onto/over the pinned 12.0 ceiling:
    1. `coalesceMessagesForCap` (`lib/src/agent/message_cap.dart`) — **CC 17 →
       CRAP 17.00** at 97.6% coverage. Only offender visible without full
       coverage (all other new/touched units measured CC ≤ 11).
    2. `_streamAssistantResponse` (`lib/src/agent/agent_loop.dart`) — the
       gh-1680 cap-heal block added 3 branches → **CC 14 → CRAP 14.00** (visible
       only on the full-suite lcov — with partial lcov it reads N/A).
    3. `_buildRequestContext` (same file) — the cap-coalesce `if` added 1
       branch → CC 12, i.e. CRAP 12.0000x at anything short of exactly 100%
       coverage (razor-edge; observed 12.0003 at 98.7%).
  - **Loc gate — RED reproduced after the first fix**: extracting the attempt
    body inline grew `agent_loop.dart` to 2816 lines > 2800. Resolved by moving
    the attempt body into the existing `agent_loop_message_cap.dart` part file
    (the seat created exactly for this gate; file now 2708 lines).
- Open review threads: **0** (all 6 resolved in earlier laps; the PR carries an
  APPROVE verdict). No `review_replies.json` entries required — written as
  `{ "replies": [] }`.

## Approach

TDD against the ratchet itself (the CI-visible failure), with the existing
suite as the behavior pin (pure control-flow/function-boundary refactor — no
wire semantics, event order, or repair logic changed):

1. **RED** — targeted + full-suite lcov merges reproduced all three CRAP
   breaches and the loc breach (17.00, 14.00, 12.0003, 2816 > 2800).
2. **GREEN** — complexity split, semantics preserved:
   - `message_cap.dart`: `coalesceMessagesForCap` (CC 17) →
     `_coalesceRegionEnd` (3), `_groupCoalesceUnits` (6), `_collectToolGroup`
     (6), `_mergeCarriersToTarget` (3), parent (3). The PR #1695 verbatim
     split-group handling, displaced-result hoisting, carrier merge order, and
     `repairToolPairing` belt-and-suspenders are untouched.
   - `agent_loop.dart` / `agent_loop_message_cap.dart`: the retry-loop body
     moved to `_streamAttempt` (CC 9); the finished-turn branch handling
     (cap heal → pairing heal) moved to `_finishedTurnResult` (CC 4); both
     resolve to a sealed `_AttemptResult` (`_AttemptReturn`/`_AttemptRetry`)
     consumed by an exhaustive switch in `_streamAssistantResponse` (CC 7).
     Cross-attempt one-shot flags (`reliefUsed`, `pairingHealed`) propagate
     through the retry value; `context` adoption is identical.
   - `_buildRequestContext` (CC 12 → 11): the nullable coalesce branch folded
     into `_applyMessageCapCoalesce` (CC 2) in the part file.
   - `_streamAttempt` + verdict types + `_finishedTurnResult` live in the part
     file — keeps `agent_loop.dart` at 2708 lines (gate ≤ 2800).
3. **REFACTOR/verify** — `dart format` + `dart analyze` clean; whole-tree
   `crap4dart analyze` on the merged lcov: **Max CRAP 12.00 — OK** (remaining
   12.00 entries are pre-existing files untouched by this diff); `check
   --baseline` 3 passed / 1 warned (duplication is warning-severity by

- `lib/src/agent/message_cap.dart` — `coalesceMessagesForCap` split into four

- `lib/src/agent/agent_loop.dart` — `_streamAssistantResponse` now only owns

{"content":"# Rework — gh-1680 / PR #1695: fix CRAP ratchet + loc gate failures (Quality gate + CRAP + duplication)

## Issues/Notes

- **CI failure root cause** (both red checks trace to one leg): the `Quality gate`
  aggregate reddens because the `CRAP + duplication` (guards) job failed. The
  job logs were not fetchable (`ci_failures_full.log` — both job logs came back
  empty), so the failure was reproduced locally step-by-step against the pinned
  `crap4dart 0.11.0`:

  - `jscpd` duplication guard (`lib/` < 1%) — 0.77%, PASS.
  - Cross-module duplication ratchet (`ci_fast_gate.sh --stages dupx`) — 0.23% <
    0.31%, PASS.
  - Loc-scope gate (`test/` + `example/` ≤ 280 lines) — PASS.
  - **CRAP ratchet (`crap4dart analyze` over the merged shard lcov) — RED
    reproduced.** CRAP = `CC² × (1−cov)³ + CC`, so any method with cyclomatic
    complexity > 12 fails *even at 100% coverage*. The PR pushed three methods
    onto/over the pinned 12.0 ceiling:
    1. `coalesceMessagesForCap` (`lib/src/agent/message_cap.dart`) — **CC 17 →
       CRAP 17.00** at 97.6% coverage. Only offender visible without full
       coverage (all other new/touched units measured CC ≤ 11).
    2. `_streamAssistantResponse` (`lib/src/agent/agent_loop.dart`) — the
       gh-1680 cap-heal block added 3 branches → **CC 14 → CRAP 14.00** (visible
       only on the full-suite lcov — with partial lcov it reads N/A).
    3. `_buildRequestContext` (same file) — the cap-coalesce `if` added 1
       branch → CC 12, i.e. CRAP 12.0000x at anything short of exactly 100%
       coverage (razor-edge; observed 12.0003 at 98.7%).

    body inline grew `agent_loop.dart` to 2816 lines > 2800. Resolved by moving
    the attempt body into the existing `agent_loop_message_cap.dart` part file
    (the seat created exactly for this gate; file now 2708 lines).
- Open review threads: **0** (all 6 resolved in earlier laps; the PR carries an
  APPROVE verdict). No `review_replies.json` entries required — written as
  `{ "replies": [] }`.

## Approach

TDD against the ratchet itself (the CI-visible failure), with the existing
suite as the behavior pin (pure control-flow/function-boundary refactor — no
wire semantics, event order, or repair logic changed):

1. **RED** — targeted + full-suite lcov merges reproduced all three CRAP

     split-group handling, displaced-result hoisting, carrier merge order, and
     `repairToolPairing` belt-and-suspenders are untouched.
   - `agent_loop.dart` / `agent_loop_message_cap.dart`: the retry-loop body

     (cap heal → pairing heal) moved to `_finishedTurnResult` (CC 4); both
     resolve to a sealed `_AttemptResult` (`_AttemptReturn`/`_AttemptRetry`)

     Cross-attempt one-shot flags (`reliefUsed`, `pairingHealed`) propagate
     through the retry value; `context` adoption is identical.
   - `_buildRequestContext` (CC 12 → 11): the nullable coalesce branch folded

   - `_streamAttempt` + verdict types + `_finishedTurnResult` live in the part

3. **REFACTOR/verify** — `dart format` + `dart analyze` clean; whole-tree
